description: About Juniper Square Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come. Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us! Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About your role Sitting within Corporate Marketing, the SEO & AEO Manager owns Juniper Square's visibility across organic search, AEO, and GEO: how we're found, ranked, and cited, in traditional search and in the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) that GPs and fund operations teams increasingly use to research vendors and ideas. Working across the broader GTM organization, you'll set the strategy, then own execution end to end, from technical foundation to AI visibility to authority building. GPs come to Juniper Square for software, for fund administration services, or increasingly both, and each entry point carries its own nuance (terminology, competitive set, audience expectations, etc.) so your strategy has to flex across the full platform rather than run one generic playbook. AEO and GEO add another layer: there's no industry-established playbook yet, and you're expected to help write one for Juniper Square rather than just execute someone else's. The right candidate uses AI as standard infrastructure and pairs technical rigor with the discipline to build processes that compound over time. The application deadline for this role is October 5th, 2026. What you’ll do Own Technical SEO Success here means organic traffic and rankings grow measurably against a defined set of priority terms across Juniper Square's full platform. Own SEO across junipersquare.com: on-page optimization, site architecture, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, and regular technical audits, partnering with our web engineering agency to scope and ship fixes. Monitor and improve sitewide crawl efficiency and indexing. Manage structured data (JSON-LD) and emerging AI crawling protocols, including llms.txt and plain-text/markdown alternates of priority pages. Own the brief and quality bar for agency and vendor relationships across SEO, AEO, and content production, deciding what stays in-house. Monitor Juniper Square's rankings against named competitors, in both traditional search and AI answer engines. When a competitor overtakes us on a priority term, diagnose why and drive the fix, whether that's a technical change, a content update, or an authority play. Win Citations Across the Open Web Success here means Juniper Square gets cited by name in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI Overviews for the private markets questions that matter, tracked against named competitors. Optimize content for LLM and AI-search visibility: schema and structured data, answer-first formatting, and semantic reinforcement that makes Juniper Square content easy for AI systems to extract and cite. Extend that visibility beyond junipersquare.com to Reddit threads, YouTube (titles, descriptions, chapters, and metadata built to rank in video results), review sites, and other community content LLMs treat as trusted sources, and direct that content to work for two readers at once, crawlers and humans, using AI-assisted workflows to scale production without lowering the quality bar. Contribute to the broader social content strategy, including LinkedIn, so format and structure support search and AI-citation goals across channels, not just engagement. Run controlled experiments to isolate what actually moves AI citations rather than treating AEO as guesswork, and turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook. Track how AI platforms retrieve, summarize, and attribute Juniper Square content, report regularly on citation share alongside organic traffic and rankings, and use that data to reprioritize the roadmap. Treat technical SEO and GEO as one program with shared priorities instead of running them as separate workstreams. Build Category Authority Success here means referring domains and citations from private markets and financial media keep growing: real evidence Juniper Square is gaining authority on private markets ideas, not just its own product terms. Build Juniper Square's authority on the ideas that define private markets, not just on product and brand terms, so we're the source search engines and AI systems point to on GP operations, fund administration, and other core private markets topics. Tailor authority-building work to how a GP is engaging us, whether that's software, fund administration, or both, since the competitors and publications that matter shift with the entry point. Partner with content and subject-matter experts to identify where Juniper Square should be the definitive answer to a private markets question but isn't yet, and close those gaps. Qualifications 5+ years in SEO, including hands-on ownership of a technical SEO program at a large B2B organization. Real, hands-on AEO/GEO experience, not just familiarity with the concept. You should be able to point to a specific citation you've earned in an AI answer engine and explain exactly how you did it. description: Role Description As Director of Pricing and Packaging at Dropbox, you will lead the strategy that determines how we package, price, and monetize our products across product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) motions. Reporting to Head of Product Marketing, you will lead a small team and partner closely with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and senior executives to make pricing and packaging a durable driver of customer value and profitable growth. This is a highly visible opportunity to help reinvent Dropbox’s monetization approach as we expand our sales-led business and build for the AI era. You will develop a holistic pricing and packaging architecture across products, customer segments, and routes to market—balancing customer adoption, competitive positioning, revenue growth, cost to serve, and margin. You will translate complex analysis into clear strategic choices, build alignment among senior leaders, and establish the capabilities and operating rhythms needed to make consistently strong monetization decisions. You will have significant exposure to Dropbox’s senior leadership team and the opportunity to shape some of the company’s most consequential growth decisions. Your work will directly influence how customers experience and value Dropbox, how our products go to market, and how the business grows over the long term. Responsibilities Define and lead Dropbox’s company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across PLG and SLG motions, customer segments, product portfolios, and geographies. Design the next generation of Dropbox’s packaging and monetization architecture, including approaches for AI-powered products and capabilities, while balancing customer value, adoption, revenue, cost to serve, and margin. Build rigorous business cases and financial models to evaluate pricing and packaging opportunities, incorporating demand, willingness to pay, competitive dynamics, usage patterns, unit economics, and potential customer and revenue impacts. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Operations leaders to translate strategy into executable plans, including research, experimentation, rollout, enablement, measurement, and iteration. Advise senior executives on high-impact monetization decisions by synthesizing complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and decision frameworks. Establish pricing and packaging governance, operating rhythms, performance metrics, and experimentation practices that improve the quality and speed of decision-making across Dropbox. Lead, develop, and inspire a small team of pricing and packaging professionals while expanding the organization’s broader monetization capabilities. Requirements 10+ years of experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, growth strategy, strategic finance, product strategy, management consulting, or a related discipline, including substantial experience in B2B SaaS. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing pricing or packaging strategies that produced measurable business or customer outcomes. Experience with both product-led and sales-led business models, including an understanding of their distinct customer journeys, routes to market, and monetization considerations. Experience building pricing business cases and financial models that connect customer behavior and willingness to pay with revenue, cost to serve, unit economics, and margin. Working knowledge of SaaS and AI monetization models, including subscription, seat-based, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid approaches. Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decisions and align senior cross-functional stakeholders around complex, high-impact initiatives. People-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing team members. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading a major pricing or packaging transformation for a multi-product or global SaaS company. Experience developing monetization strategies for AI-powered products, including evaluating inference or infrastructure costs, usage economics, value metrics, and margin implications. Experience managing the intersection of self-serve, enterprise, and partner-led offerings within a shared product portfolio. Experience with pricing research and experimentation methods such as conjoint analysis, willingness-to-pay research, price elasticity analysis, customer segmentation, or controlled testing. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: Understand yourself and others. Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader in the $100B+ CPaaS market. Customers including Airbnb, Snapchat, and thousands of enterprises depend on our APIs and SDKs to deliver SMS, voice, and messaging at scale. The Technical Routing & Quality team sits at the heart of this — owning the configuration and performance of every message and call that traverses the Vonage network. Why This Role Matters Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin. What You Will Do Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS What You Will Bring Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent) Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams Nice to have Familiarity with voice routing metrics (ASR, NER, MOS, PDD) and SIP fundamentals Experience with ML-driven or algorithmic routing systems Knowledge of RCS, Network APIs, or US direct carrier connectivity Background in a CPaaS, wholesale telco, or carrier operations environment About the Team The Technical Routing & Quality team is focused on three objectives: reducing tech debt, automating the core business, and investing in growth areas such as Network APIs, RCS, and US direct connectivity. We operate a follow-the-sun model and work closely with Carrier Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to deliver best-in-class routing services. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. description: Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. He or she is an independent contributor who is comfortable launching, managing and optimizing campaigns. The Paid Search Specialist has experience and expertise concerning every aspect of successful paid search efforts, including: Account, campaign and ad group set up Conversion tracking Ad copy creation Keyword research and selection Budget management Report creation and presentation Reporting This role is within Brafton's Paid Search team and reports into the Director of Paid Search. Set up all components of campaigns and ad groups, including ensuring that all tracking is correctly and fully implemented. Create and present compelling paid search proposals/audits. Successfully execute planned campaigns - optimizing on a daily basis, as necessary, in Google Ads or any other tools and platforms in use. Report on your results internally and externally in a clear, compelling fashion. Collaborate closely with the account’s internal stakeholders and client contacts. Bring a consultative approach to client campaigns, proactively ideating around and bringing forth the best possible paid search strategies to achieve client's marketing goals within budget. Understand PPC best practices and provide insight through client deliverables. Reliable management and reporting of monthly assigned PPC work. Key Success Factors Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Paid Ads, conversion tracking and ROI based digital ad campaigns. Demonstrated ability to successfully manage PPC campaigns for B2B/B2C clients. Excellent client-facing communication skills (via phone, email, and video call). The ability to create clear reports with riveting ROI narrative. Strong interdepartmental and interpersonal skills. The ability to work at a computer during standard working hours. Meet scheduled and proposed deadlines. The drive to consistently improve upon current ROAS and other PPC metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, etc.). Skills & Requirements Bachelor’s degree preferred. Minimum two years of relevant work experience Excellent written and verbal English communication skills Expert knowledge with the following technologies/software/programs/processes: Google: Ads, Keyword Planner Tool, Search Console, Analytics, gMail Basic Knowledge in or experience with similar tools such as: SearchAds360, SEMRush, Searchmetrics, Raven Tools, Buzzsuomo, Moz, Wordstream, Spyfu, or similar platforms. Basic knowledge of PPC conversion tracking and ability to troubleshoot assignments. Ability to adapt to new software and changes in the paid environment quickly Ability to meet deadlines within a fast-paced marketing Agency environment Time Breakout 20 percent client communication 20 percent internal communication 40 percent execution/production 10 percent reporting 10 percent miscellaneous Compensation Additional Information
